optimization_unit.name: Exact-V8 existing-component membership reconstruction
optimization_unit.question: Can a complete, non-cherry-picked reconstruction of the five existing V8 strategy components reduce temporal loss concentration and closed-balance drawdown while retaining whole stressed value, without inventing freed-capacity outcomes or new entries?
optimization_unit.mechanism_boundary: Static membership removal and reconstruction, local executable reallocation inside frozen memberships, and component-local causal loss suspension on the unchanged exact-V8 opportunity universe.
optimization_unit.independence_from_unit_001: Unit 001 retained all five components while changing continuous weights, aggregate admission and one portfolio-global realized-drawdown multiplier. Unit 002 exhaustively changes component membership, then tests only within-membership reallocation and component-local loss-triggered suspension.

frozen_future_inputs.role: three frozen Unit-001 Stage-B static seeds

input_staging_boundary.rule: No input copy, config, executable proxy implementation or result may be created until this declaration commit is verified on origin/main.

this_unit_is_limited_to: Executable weight reallocation only among active members
Component-local causal loss suspension of future existing opportunities
optimization_scope.new_entry_strategy_definition: Any new symbol, timeframe, signal family, direction or opportunity timestamp not emitted by exact V8, including loosening or rewriting entry conditions to manufacture an opportunity.

shared_executable_proxy_contract.risk_capital: minimum of actual balance, stressed balance and source pre-order risk-capital haircut applied to actual balance

ordered_deep_stages.enumeration: For each of three frozen static seeds, enumerate integer masks 1 through 31 over RC61, RC64, Cross, Intraday and Return. Preserve the seed weight when its bit is one and set it to zero when its bit is zero; Passive remains zero.
ordered_deep_stages.deduplication: Deduplicate exact five-weight vectors while preserving all seed/mask provenance. Canonical role order is lexicographic five-weight order followed by seed/mask provenance order.

eligibility.common: Actual net, stressed net and minimum balance must be positive for development as a whole and for 2024 and 2025 separately.
eligibility.primary: Development stressed net must retain at least 75% of the exact-V8 development anchor and actual closed-balance DD must be no more than 27%.
eligibility.fallback: Development stressed net must retain at least 65% of the exact-V8 development anchor and actual DD must improve by at least five percentage points versus the exact-V8 development anchor.
eligibility.membership_robustness: An eligible unique role is robust only if at least two distinct eligible unique roles are adjacent through a one-bit add/remove relation in at least one shared seed provenance.

ordered_deep_stages.center_selection: Use the active primary tier if nonempty, otherwise fallback. Rank robust centers by highest weakest annual stressed net, stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, stressed net, lower DD, then canonical role order. Select at most three with pairwise membership Hamming distance at least two; fill remaining slots by rank if separation prevents three.
ordered_deep_stages.no_eligible_fallback: If no robust eligible center exists, select up to three separated valid near-miss roles by the normalized sum of annual-positivity, stressed-retention and DD deficits, then efficiency and canonical order. This preserves mandatory deep investigation without declaring economic success.

ordered_deep_stages.active_component_bounds: Clip each active component to 0.50 through that component's exact-V8 weight. Inactive components remain exactly zero; Passive zero, base position risk 0.04 and aggregate risk 0.12 remain fixed.
ordered_deep_stages.deduplication: Deduplicate exact executable weight vectors across centers and retain center provenance.
ordered_deep_stages.eligibility: Use Stage-A common, primary and fallback economic gates unchanged. Eligible fine-neighbor robustness requires at least min(4, 2 * active-member-count) eligible one-step neighbors spanning at least min(3, active-member-count) active weight axes.
ordered_deep_stages.center_selection: Use the same tier, ranking, separation and at-most-three rule as Stage A. If no robust eligible center exists, advance up to three declared near misses by the same normalized-deficit rule.

ordered_deep_stages.causal_state_rule: Each active component owns an independent consecutive-loss counter. An admitted close with scaled actual net below zero increments it; an admitted close with actual net at or above zero resets it. Reaching the trigger resets the streak and suppresses only the next K future accepted-source birth events of that same component, decrementing once per such event. Existing positions are never force-closed and inactive members never reactivate.
ordered_deep_stages.outcome_boundary: Suppressed accepted-source births contribute zero. Source-blocked opportunities remain outcome-unknown and receive zero profit credit even if native capacity could admit them.
ordered_deep_stages.development_gate: Use Stage-A economic gates; a nonneutral role must trigger and suppress at least one otherwise executable birth. Nonneutral neighbor robustness requires at least two eligible immediate grid neighbors spanning both trigger and suspension axes.
ordered_deep_stages.neutral_precedence: A robust eligible nonneutral role outranks its static neutral seed only if it improves weakest annual stressed net, then stressed-net-to-DD efficiency. Otherwise the neutral seed remains eligible; causal code is investigated but never forced into the candidate.
ordered_deep_stages.validation: Evaluate at most three development-selected immutable roles from a fresh $100 January-May replay with clean component state. Actual net, stressed net and minimum balance must be positive, DD must not exceed 30%, and stressed net must retain at least 65% of the exact-V8 validation anchor.

ordered_deep_stages.cost_book: Judge both actual net and the already recorded doubled-observed-cost stressed net; fit no new cost model.
ordered_deep_stages.block_gate: Every opened block starts at $100 with clean causal state and must have positive actual net, positive stressed net, positive minimum balance and actual closed-balance DD no greater than 30%.
ordered_deep_stages.whole_gate: Continuous 2024-01 through 2026-07 replay must retain at least 75% of exact-V8 whole stressed net and improve actual closed-balance DD by at least five percentage points.
ordered_deep_stages.ranking: Maximize weakest block stressed net, then whole stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, whole stressed net, lower whole DD and canonical role order. Locked holdout never selects an alternate.
ordered_deep_stages.empty_input_rule: If Stage C has zero validation-passing immutable roles, Stage D records all declared blocks as zero-input/zero-run and closes the Unit validly empty; it does not reopen a validation failure.

ordered_deep_stages.conditional: Exactly one unchanged Stage-D winner may enter.
ordered_deep_stages.purpose: Establish native freed-capacity admissions, open-equity DD, stop quantization and full Tester economics that the accepted-source proxy cannot claim.
ordered_deep_stages.authority: A native result can close or support U002 but cannot modify or promote Live directly.

closure_and_correction_rules.economic_closure: Only after Stages A through D are completed as declared and no immutable Stage-D survivor exists, or after the sole valid Stage-E finalist nonconfirms with no declared layer remaining.
closure_and_correction_rules.required_after_closure: Freeze the whole Unit bundle, then recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before opening any successor.
